name: kaaro-fireworks
description: Dev-only tooling. The site itself is static (no build step); nothing here is shipped to Netlify.

scripts.check:js: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('js')) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'js/' + f], {stdio: 'inherit'})"
